name: Five Nights at Freddy's Soulless Look
summary:
Welcome to the new and colorful FreddyBears Family Fun,

where a big smile is always welcome.

Your job seems simple: use the phone to pre-record a guide message for the next night guards.

But while you work, make sure those things don’t get into the office.

Got it, Ralph?
